title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana Completes 7 Years
content:
🏛️ PM-KMY Marks 7 Years of Social Security for Farmers

👤 Who → Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs)

📋 What → Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY) completed 7 years

📍 Where → Pan-India, launched 12 September 2019

🎯 Purpose → Provide old-age social security (pension) to Small and Marginal Farmers

📌 Important Facts
▪️ Type: Central Sector, voluntary and contributory pension scheme
▪️ Eligible age: 18–40 years; landholding up to 2 hectares
▪️ Monthly contribution: ₹55–₹200; assured pension: minimum ₹3,000/month after 60 years
▪️ Family pension: 50% of subscriber's pension (₹1,500/month)
▪️ Pension Fund Manager: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
▪️ Total enrolment: 24,96,252 farmers (as of 08 Feb 2026)

⚠️ Exam Angle → Launch date (12 Sept 2019), contribution slab, and Pension Fund Manager (LIC) are frequently tested

#25September2026

question: Which institution has been designated the Pension Fund Manager for the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY), which completed 7 years in September 2026?
options: B) Life Insurance Corporation of India
answer: B) Life Insurance Corporation of India
explanation: PM-KMY, launched 12 Sept 2019 for Small and Marginal Farmers (18-40 years, up to 2 hectares land), assures a minimum pension of ₹3,000/month, managed by LIC. SBI is a bank, not a pension fund manager here; ESIC covers organised-sector workers; NPS Trust manages the National Pension System, a separate scheme. #25September2026
